## Samsung Art Store Partners with Kunsthistorisches Museum Vienna to Bring Austrian Masterpieces to Global TV Audiences

Minor brand and content positioning story with no identifiable financial thesis signal; relevant only as a consumer lifestyle marker for Samsung's premium TV ecosystem, not a catalyst for the stock.

- Samsung Electronics announced an Art Store content partnership with the Kunsthistorisches Museum Vienna, one of the world's major art history collections.
- The deal surfaces the museum's key holdings on Samsung TV screens for global audiences.
- Multiple Korean and international outlets covered the announcement, indicating an active Samsung PR push.
